text:
tara: Kickoff for ACME on-prem GPU cluster bring-up (EU-west-3 edge).
tara: Window: Thu 2025-03-12 22:00 UTC. Air-gapped install, VPC peering to customer's transit via GRE/BGP over the jumpbox. Expected hardware: 4 x A100 nodes (32 GPUs total across cluster), k8s v1.29, calico CNI, on-prem NFS for model artifacts.
tara: Minimal checklist (we'll iterate):
 - signed VPN cert + jumpbox SSH key delivered
 - BGP ASN & peering IPs from customer
 - IP allocation plan (pod/service/node CIDRs)
 - seed OS image + offline package tarball verified
 - firewall rules for peering & metrics (SNAT egress exception)
 - KMS/HSM key access validated (if customer using HSM)
 - perf smoke: nvidia-smi, small perf run (1 requester, 16 GPU tokens)
 - observability: Prometheus scrape + alerting + Loki retention set to 14d

matt: @tara do we have the customer's ASN and the peering IPs yet? Need to confirm before we handoff to networking for route filters. :eyes:
esshan: Yes — ASN 64532, peering IPs 10.254.1.2 (customer) <-> 10.254.1.1 (jumpbox). They want /29 for the peering and a routed /23 for the node pool. Proposed podCIDR: 10.10.0.0/16, svcCIDR: 10.11.0.0/20.
esshan: Calico tweak — set BGPMesh off and enable IP-in-IP for cross-node pods. Example Config snippet:```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: BGPConfiguration
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  asNumber: 64532
  nodeToNodeMeshEnabled: false
---
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: FelixConfiguration
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  ipipEnabled: true
``` 
sre-oncall: For monitoring, make sure Prometheus scrapes /metrics on 9100 and node-exporter has the GPU exporter (dcgm-exporter) enabled. Alerting: gpu_utilization > 85% for 10m -> page on-call. Also add a runbook link in the alert.
sre-oncall: Also ensure we don't scrape customer-internal endpoints. Prometheus must use the cluster-proxy jumpbox and only egress to customer peering IPs.
customer-success: Confirmed: seed USB + signed certs shipped UPS overnight. Firewall team opened ports to 10.254.1.1/29 and allowed 2049 TCP for NFS, 22 for provisioning, and 123/4500 for IPsec/IKE (only with jumpbox IP). ETA on-site arrival: Thu 18:30 local.
devops-bot: provisioning-job #PJ-9876 started by @tara. Steps: PXE -> seed image verify -> k8s bootstrap. Logs: https://internal.corp/builds/PJ-9876 (accessible to eng only).
esshan: Quick smoke commands we'll run post-bootstrap:```bash
ssh root@jumpbox
kubectl get nodes -o wide
# expect 4 nodes Ready
kubectl get pods -n redwood-system
nvidia-smi -L
``` 
esshan: sample expected output snippet:```text
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
gpu-node-1   Ready    64d   v1.29   10.12.0.5   ...
gpu-node-2   Ready    64d   v1.29   10.12.0.6   ...
$ nvidia-smi -L
GPU 0: A100-SXM4-40GB (UUID: GPU-...)
``` 
tara: Post-boot validation plan (short):
 1) confirm node count and labels (role=gpu, rack/zone tags)
 2) run small perf job (containerized benchmark) to validate throughput and KV cache behaviour
 3) verify model artifact NFS mount on all nodes and permissions
 4) run end-to-end inference smoke against local model (10 requests with streaming)
 5) confirm OpenTelemetry traces show request path through jumpbox -> inference pod -> response

matt: Cost note — customer requested cluster reserved for 12 months. Recommend enabling autosuspend for idle GPU pools and set default instance queueing to avoid accidental scale-up. Estimate monthly infra ops: ~ $26k (power + rack + warranty), add Redwood Dedicated management surcharge if they want managed ops.
customer-success: Handoff call scheduled Fri 2025-03-13 09:00 UTC with ACME infra + security. I'll join and demo the console and alert emails.
sre-oncall: After handoff, @tara assign post-handoff SLO owner for first 30 days. We'll run daily health sweeps (cpu/gpu/mem/ephemeral disk) and one weekly perf regression test.
tara: Will do. I'll be on-call for the first 36 hours after bring-up. After that hand to @sre-oncall. I'll post the final runbook with exact command outputs and the prom alert links in this thread once PJ-9876 finishes.
devops-bot: provisioning-job #PJ-9876: step 3/12 "k8s-bootstrap" finished (exit 0).
